name: grok-bitch
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the grok-bitch plugin — a Rick & Morty cast of Claude subagents that hands grunt work to a caged, independently-verified Morty, hardened by the bundled Aletheia truth-finding method.

plugins.name: grok-bitch
plugins.description: Offload mechanical, well-specified, verifiable grunt work to Morty — a bounded, untrusted-by-default Claude subagent his handler independently verifies (never trusts his word). The safety cage is now a discipline the cast runs under (bounded scope + guard/revert on protected paths + a verify gate + never self-certify), not an external binary. Includes auto-discovered skills — the cast's rigor plus the bundled Aletheia truth-finding method and its interferometry instruments — and a Rick-and-Morty cast of subagents: Rick (Opus handler that orchestrates Morty in an isolated context), Mr. Meeseeks (Sonnet, completes one bounded task then vanishes), and Jerry (fast cheap Claude Haiku for trivial scraps). Earlier versions caged an external grok model through a CLI; both have been retired — pure Claude now.
